final_wiki.Q-5438:
The largest prime number less than 1840 is 1831.

Verification:
- 1839 = 3 × 613 (divisible by 3)
- 1838 = 2 × 919 (even)
- 1837 = 11 × 167 (composite)
- 1836 = even
- 1835 = divisible by 5
- 1834 = even
- 1833 = divisible by 3
- 1832 = even
- 1831 = prime (not divisible by any prime up to √1831 ≈ 42.8)
